description: This script generates coverage reports from llvm coverage data, including merging coverage data, generating HTML and gcov reports, and handling test binaries and coverage files.

methods.name: _get_raw_reports
methods.description: Retrieves raw coverage report files from the coverage directory based on test binaries.

methods.name: _get_test_binary_paths
methods.description: Determines the paths to test binaries, deducing from coverage data if not specified.

methods.name: _get_exclude_opts
methods.description: Generates a list of filename regex patterns to exclude from coverage analysis.

methods.name: _generate_reports
methods.description: Creates coverage reports in HTML and/or gcov formats based on merged coverage data.

methods.name: _merge_coverage_data
methods.description: Merges raw coverage reports into a single coverage data file.

methods.name: create_report
methods.description: Main function to generate coverage reports, merging data and creating HTML/gcov reports.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script, parsing arguments and initiating report creation.
